description: A music studio and second dwelling on the lowest part of the plot, floating entirely on short posts with no earthworks. Long and thin with its length on the contour - that is what makes it work. Across only 5 m of width the ground falls 1.55 m, so the posts stay short and 4.14 m of headroom survives under the height limit. Turn the same area into a square and the drop doubles and the headroom disappears.

alternative_for_100_m2.layout: two decks of 10 x 5 linked by a bridge

why_not_100_m2_in_one: a 12 x 8.3 footprint spans 3.24 m of drop, needs a 3.54 m post and leaves 2.46 m - no ceiling. The largest single floating platform here is about 80 m2, and only as a bar.
